from openpyxl import load_workbook
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Group class codes by student code, preserving the original order
grouped = OrderedDict()
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):  # row 1 contains headers
    student_code = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    
    if student_code is None or class_code is None:
        continue
    
    if student_code not in grouped:
        grouped[student_code] = []
    grouped[student_code].append(class_code)

# Only modify the allowed range G11:R13
start_row, end_row = 11, 13
start_col, end_col = 7, 18

# Clear the allowed range first
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = None

# Write the horizontal transposed data into G11:R13
for row_offset, (student_code, class_codes) in enumerate(grouped.items()):
    target_row = start_row + row_offset
    if target_row > end_row:
        break
    
    values = [student_code] + class_codes
    for col_offset, value in enumerate(values[:end_col - start_col + 1]):
        ws.cell(row=target_row, column=start_col + col_offset).value = value

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
